authority: Supreme Court of the United Kingdom

steps.title: Pre-Application Requirements
steps.description: Parties may be required to attend a Mediation Information and Assessment Meeting (MIAM) before applying to court, where applicable.

steps.title: Filing of Application
steps.description: Application relating to divorce, financial remedies, or child arrangements is filed before the Family Court.

steps.title: Service of Application
steps.description: Court serves the application on the respondent in accordance with the Family Procedure Rules.

steps.title: Response and Statements
steps.description: Respondent files an acknowledgment or response, and parties submit required statements or forms.

steps.title: Hearings and Case Management
steps.description: Court conducts case management hearings and issues directions, including safeguarding checks where children are involved.

steps.title: Evidence and Submissions
steps.description: Parties submit evidence and make submissions in accordance with court directions.

steps.title: Final Hearing
steps.description: Court hears final arguments and evidence, where required.

steps.title: Order / Decree
steps.description: Court issues an order or decree resolving the family matter.

documents_required: Marriage or civil partnership certificate (if applicable)

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal on a point of law or procedure as permitted under Family Procedure Rules

escalation_paths.to: Supreme Court of the United Kingdom
escalation_paths.condition: Appeal on a point of law of general public importance
